plan.notes: Source: College of Staten Island (CUNY) official Coursedog catalog PDF, Biology department, "Degree Map Name: BIO-BS:ECOEVOBEH | 2024-PRESENT", "Total Degree Map Credits 120 - 123", Degree Map Effective Catalog Year printed as "2026 -" (truncated in the PDF; filed as 2026-2027, disclosed here). Transcribed exactly as published at the map’s minimum credit values: 15+15+15+15+16+15+14+15 = 120, within the map’s published 120-123 range; every semester sum matches the map’s declared Actual Credits at the chosen values. Credit ranges resolved at minimum per project rule with disclosure: the Year 1 Spring calculus block is listed 4-7 (transcribed at 4; the map does not itemize the lecture/lab split; MTH 229 is a 1-credit lab per the map). Lecture+lab pairs the map treats as single requirement blocks (BIO 170/171, BIO 180/181, CHM 141/121, CHM 142/127) are transcribed as one combined slot each so no lecture/lab credit split is invented. "OR" alternates folded into choice slots with the map’s option lists; unnamed Flexible Core / College Option / elective slots transcribed as choice slots with the map literal as title. Prerequisites recorded only where the map states a clear in-plan course prerequisite (CHM 142 block: CHM 141/121; CHM 250: CHM 142/127; CHM 256: CHM 250; PHY 160 block: PHY 116; BIO 272: BIO 180/181; ENG 151: ENG 111). Prerequisites for track-elective options vary by course and are documented in the slot notes. The World Cultures option list includes AAD 105, which the map itself marks "(Inactive)" - flagged, not silently dropped. Course titles verified against the map text. This is the Ecology, Evolution and Behavior track; the map also publishes BIOGEN and MOLCELLDEV tracks (not transcribed).
